sun-ruins.title: Guild hall
sun-ruins.content: The adventurers' guild hall: a smoky common room, a hearth with the job board beside it, and Ponticius's desk at the back where contracts are signed.

sun-ruins.title: Ponticius
sun-ruins.content: Ponticius is the gruff guild master. He runs the job board, haggles hard over fees and pays rewards out of the guild vault.

sun-ruins.title: The sphinx
sun-ruins.content: A stone sphinx guards the gate of the Sun Ruins. It asks one riddle; the answer is the moon. A wrong answer wakes the sand beneath the gate.

sun-ruins.title: Solari glyphs
sun-ruins.content: Angular Solari glyphs cover the gates and walls of the Sun Ruins; few living scholars can read them.

sun-ruins.title: Mother's farm
sun-ruins.content: Max and Luke's mother keeps a small farm two days north of the city; she disapproves of the guild.

noir.title: The Blue Anchor
noir.content: A dockside bar on Mercer Street with a back room used for deals; Maeve sings there most nights.

noir.title: Brandt's habits
noir.content: Lieutenant Brandt of the harbor police wears tailored suits and drives a black sedan on a lieutenant's salary.

noir.title: Pier Street safehouse
noir.content: A rented room above a fishmonger on Pier Street where the department hides witnesses.

noir.title: Maeve's stage act
noir.content: Maeve closes every set at the Blue Anchor with 'Harbor Lights'; regulars throw carnations.
